title: Total current calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the total current in part (1) as 6.5 A (or 13/2 A).

title: Parallel voltage recognition
description: Important: The student must recognize that the voltage across all three parallel resistors is the same.

title: Ohm's Law application
description: Important: The student must correctly apply Ohm's Law (I = V/R or V = IR) to find currents or voltages for individual resistors.

title: Kirchhoff's Current Law
description: Important: The student must apply the junction rule to sum the parallel branch currents to find the total current.

title: Equivalent resistance for part (2)
description: Important: For part (2), the student must calculate the correct equivalent parallel resistance (12/13 Ω) to find the common voltage.

title: Individual currents for part (2)
description: Essential: The student must provide the three correct branch currents for part (2) (18/13 A, 12/13 A, 9/13 A).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student maintains consistent use of amperes (A) and volts (V) throughout the solution.

title: Incorrect parallel formula
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly adds parallel resistances as R1 + R2 + R3.

title: Sign or arithmetic error
description: Pitfall: Penalize for significant arithmetic mistakes in calculating currents, voltages, or the equivalent resistance.
